name: com.eliranshaya.mobileadjustgamequality
description: Generates one mobile-tuned URP asset, renderer and quality level, applies the recommended mobile Player Settings, and gives you a prefab that keeps the frame budget on the device. Quality is one number - which rung of a nine-rung ladder is applied - moved by measured frame times and by the thermal state the OS reports, on Android and iOS. Includes a developer overlay.
